base_member_text: L32 assigns scalar offset to variable named diff (shadows MATLAB builtin diff); L33 freq=freq+diff shifts the whole grid by the fp mismatch, so the actual grid no longer starts exactly at fmin (relation L7/L10 vs L32-33)
audit_member_text: L32 computes only the nonnegative magnitude of the nearest-grid difference, then L33 always adds it to every frequency; when the nearest frequency lies above fp, this shifts it farther above fp instead of locking fp to a component.

base_member_text: Hs_output (L73) is computed but is not among the function outputs (L1-2) and is not otherwise used
audit_member_text: Hs_output is assigned at L73 but is neither returned in L1-L2 nor subsequently used.

base_member_text: host_freqs_idx first-element check compares against 0 (L57) although idx_theta:mtheta:mfreq starting value 0 can only occur when idx_theta==0 (L36,L56)
audit_member_text: idx_theta can be zero or exceed mfreq at L36; L56 can then produce [0] or an empty vector, L58 may delete its only element, and L57/L60 index the first/end element without an emptiness check.

base_member_text: All physical inputs (fmax,fmin,mfreq,mtheta,depth,g,fp,gamma_spec,sigma_theta,theta_mean,Hmo) come from inputs.mat (L4) whose contents are not visible in this file
